Hi there! 👋 Welcome to TwitCanva's creative assistant!

Whether you're brainstorming ideas for social media graphics, AI art, or video projects, need help crafting the perfect generation prompt, want feedback on a piece you've made, or just need a spark of creative inspiration, I'm here to help.

A few quick things I can support you with:
- Build detailed, structured prompts for any visual style (photorealistic, anime, retro, watercolor, cinematic, etc.)
- Brainstorm content ideas for Reels/TikToks, social posts, marketing assets, or personal creative projects
- Share composition, color, and lighting tips to make your visuals pop
- Help you nail a specific vibe or aesthetic you're going for

What are you working on today? 😊
